selection_rationale: Indices 0, 1, 3, 4, and 6 are all explicit surveys of monocular depth estimation, covering general methods, metric depth, self‑supervised approaches, dynamic scenes, and a broad overview respectively. They directly match the target topic and are likely to contain comprehensive literature reviews and benchmark discussions needed for a synthesis. The remaining papers focus on unrelated domains (human pose, binocular stereo) or lack sufficient relevance.
